title: Microsoft Purview DLP: guided diagnostics for why a policy acted
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout facts, licensing qualifications, Security Copilot controls and metering statements are supported. Add the Microsoft reference that distinguishes organisation-wide plugin restrictions from the per-user source toggle.

claims.where: title; front matter: products; What's changing
claims.claim: This change introduces guided diagnostics in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention.
claims.quote: We’re introducing a new guided diagnostics experience to help users understand why their DLP policies may not be behaving as expected.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The diagnostics explain why a DLP action was taken on a document.
claims.quote: This experience provides a clear summary of why a DLP action was taken on a document

claims.quote: including which policies were triggered

claims.quote: the order of evaluation

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: The diagnostics show which conditions evaluated as true or false.
claims.quote: detailed insights into which conditions evaluated as true or false.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes Copilot-powered insights and tailored troubleshooting and policy optimisation recommendations for Microsoft 365 E5 customers.
claims.quote: For Microsoft 365 E5 customers, the experience also includes Copilot-powered insights and tailored recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Licence
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap nor the supplied notice names a base-diagnostics licence.
claims.quote: The diagnostics will be available to all users who have permission to view DLP policies. ... Security Copilot-powered insights are available only to customers with eligible Microsoft 365 E5 and Copilot licensing

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Licence; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A licence specific to the base guided diagnostics has not been published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Purview" "guided diagnostics" "license"; Purview "561032" diagnostics SCU licensing. Read the notice, dlp-test-dlp-policies and self-help diagnostics; service-description and billing-model search excerpts gave no licence specific to this experience.

claims.claim: Mixed licensing describes E5 eligibility together with Security Copilot consumption capacity, while base-diagnostics licensing remains unconfirmed.
claims.quote: Accessing Security Copilot through a Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 license uses the inclusion capacity model.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: A Microsoft Learn page specifically describing the new guided per-document experience was not found as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "guided diagnostics" "DLP"; Purview "561032" diagnostics SCU licensing. Opened dlp-test-dlp-policies, copilot-in-purview-overview and self-help diagnostics. The latter documents existing diagnostic scenarios, not this new Copilot-assisted evaluation-summary experience.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the DLP locations covered by this new guided experience.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview DLP "guided diagnostics" licensing locations conditions permissions enable disable; "guided diagnostics" "DLP". Read self-help diagnostics and dlp-test-dlp-policies; their existing scenario coverage does not identify this roadmap feature's location coverage.

claims.where: Why it matters; Scope; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified which condition types the new guided experience supports.
claims.quote: Searched: "DLP" "guided diagnostics" "SCU" "conditions" "metadata"; Purview DLP "guided diagnostics" licensing locations conditions permissions enable disable. Read dlp-test-dlp-policies and self-help diagnostics; neither gives condition-type coverage for this new experience.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described the document details shown by the new guided diagnostics.
claims.quote: Searched: "DLP" "guided diagnostics" "SCU" "conditions" "metadata"; "guided diagnostics" "DLP". Read the notice, dlp-test-dlp-policies and self-help diagnostics; no passage specifies document-detail disclosure in the new experience.

claims.claim: The supplied notice does not define the roles that grant permission to view DLP policies.
claims.quote: The diagnostics will be available to all users who have permission to view DLP policies.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; controls[0].api; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: No separate UI or automation control is documented to enable, disable or restrict access to the new guided diagnostics.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview DLP guided diagnostics tenant switch access permissions PowerShell Security Compliance. Read self-help diagnostics and DLP cmdlet search excerpts; they document existing troubleshooting and policy retrieval, not a switch or separate access restriction for this experience.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 services data access is configured in the Security Copilot portal at Settings > Owner settings.
claims.quote: Use the following steps to turn on or off Security Copilot's access to Microsoft 365 services. 1. In Security Copilot, go to Settings > Owner settings. 2. Update your data sharing selection.

claims.claim: An API or command equivalent for the Microsoft 365 services data access setting is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Security Copilot API Microsoft 365 services data access Owner settings Purview plugin enable disable PowerShell; "Security Copilot" "Microsoft 365" "data access" "API". Opened privacy-data-security, owner-settings and auto-provisioning-security-copilot; no equivalent call found.

claims.claim: Managing Owner settings requires the Security Copilot owner role.
claims.quote: You need the Security Copilot owner role to manage owner settings.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; controls[1].scope; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The organisation's Microsoft 365 services data access setting governs Security Copilot integration with Purview.
claims.quote: This setting allows customers to configure whether Security Copilot can query information directly from Microsoft 365 services such as Microsoft Purview.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling Microsoft 365 service data sharing prevents the organisation from using Copilot with Purview.
claims.quote: Customers can choose not to share their Microsoft 365 service data with Copilot in the Owner settings page. However, the organization won't be able to use Copilot with Microsoft 365 products such as like Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 services data access defaults to ON for auto-provisioned E5 and E7 customers.
claims.quote: What configuration settings are preselected during auto provisioning? ... Security Copilot access to data from Microsoft 365 services (turned on by default)

claims.claim: The Purview source toggle is in the Security Copilot portal at Sources > Manage plugins > Purview.
claims.quote: Open https://securitycopilot.microsoft.com/. ... Open Sources in the prompt bar. ... On the Manage plugins page, set the Purview toggle to On to enable or Off to disable.

claims.claim: An API or command equivalent for the per-user Purview source toggle is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Security Copilot" "API" "plugins" "settings" enable disable; Security Copilot API Microsoft 365 services data access Owner settings Purview plugin enable disable PowerShell. Opened use-plugins, manage-plugins and copilot-in-purview-overview; no equivalent call found.

claims.claim: Security Copilot in Purview is enabled by default.
claims.quote: Security Copilot in Purview is enabled by default.

claims.where: controls[2].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Purview source must be enabled for both standalone and embedded Security Copilot experiences in Purview.
claims.quote: Security Copilot in Purview must be enabled for both the standalone and embedded experiences to work.

claims.claim: The source toggle personalises the user's active plugins and is a user-scoped control.
claims.quote: To personalize the way Security Copilot interacts with you ... Turn any plugin on or off ... Select which plugins Security Copilot uses as a data source by turning service toggles on or off.

claims.claim: The per-user source toggle is distinct from the organisation-wide plugin availability restriction.
claims.quote: As an administrator, you have full control over which plugins are available across your organization. You can choose to make specific plugins accessible to everyone or restrict them to owners only.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/security/manage-plugins to sources to substantiate the distinction between the per-user source toggle and organisation-wide plugin availability restrictions.

claims.claim: Security Copilot may copy, process and store relevant Customer Data to provide responses.
claims.quote: Relevant Customer Data may be copied, processed, and stored by Security Copilot to provide responses.

claims.claim: Customer Data shared with Security Copilot is governed by Security Copilot product terms, data protection commitments and documentation.
claims.quote: Customer Data shared with Security Copilot is governed by the Product Terms, Data Protection Addendum, and documentation applicable to Security Copilot.

claims.claim: DLP rules run in priority order within a policy.
claims.quote: When content is evaluated against rules, the rules are processed in priority order.

claims.claim: For hosted locations such as Exchange, SharePoint and OneDrive, the first evaluated matching rule with the most restrictive action is enforced.
claims.quote: For the hosted service locations, like Exchange, SharePoint, and OneDrive ... If content matches multiple rules, the first rule evaluated that has the most restrictive action is enforced.

claims.claim: Security Copilot compute is measured in Security Compute Units.
claims.quote: Security Compute Units (SCUs) represent the compute capacity required to run Security Copilot workloads.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The Security Copilot-powered insights consume SCUs under the embedded-experience capacity model.
claims.quote: You consume SCUs in the following scenarios: ... Running embedded Security Copilot experiences

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 inclusion provides 400 SCUs monthly for every 1,000 paid user licences.
claims.quote: Customers with Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 will have 400 Security Compute Units (SCU) each month for every 1,000 paid user license

claims.claim: The included monthly allocation is capped at 10,000 SCUs.
claims.quote: up to 10,000 SCUs each month

claims.claim: The E5 and E7 monthly SCU allocation carries no additional cost.
claims.quote: up to 10,000 SCUs each month at no additional cost.

claims.claim: Learn says consumption beyond included SCUs will be throttled at a future date.
claims.quote: Usage beyond the allocated SCUs will be throttled at a future date.

claims.claim: At that future date, customers can scale beyond included capacity at $6 USD per SCU on a pay-as-you-go basis.
claims.quote: Customers have an option to scale beyond the allocated amount at $6 USD for each SCU on a pay-as-you go basis at that time.

claims.claim: Customers without qualifying E5 or E7 licences can continue using Security Copilot under its existing pricing model.
claims.quote: Customers without Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 licenses can continue to access Security Copilot using the existing pricing model.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: An SCU rate specific to these guided diagnostics has not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview "561032" diagnostics SCU licensing; "DLP" "guided diagnostics" "SCU" "conditions" "metadata". Opened security-copilot-inclusion, security-compute-units-capacity and copilot-in-purview-overview; none gives a diagnostics-specific SCU rate.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: SCU use can be tracked in the Security Copilot standalone portal's usage dashboard.
claims.quote: Customers are able to track their usage in the in-product usage dashboard in the Security Copilot standalone portal.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Test-DlpPolicies is an existing diagnostic cmdlet that reports which SharePoint- and OneDrive-scoped DLP policies match an individual item there.
claims.quote: Test-DlpPolicies is a cmdlet that allows you to see which DLP policies scoped to SharePoint and OneDrive match (or don't match) an individual item in SharePoint or OneDrive.

claims.claim: Test-DlpPolicies does not support complex, grouped or nested conditions.
claims.quote: Test-DlpPolices works only with simple conditions. It doesn't work with complex, grouped, or nested conditions.

claims.claim: Test-DlpPolicies sends its report to the SMTP address supplied through -SendReportTo.
claims.quote: The report is sent to the SMTP address specified in the -SendReportTo parameter of the Test-DlpPolicies command.

claims.claim: The variable cost rating reflects the SCU-metered Security Copilot insights, including use of allocated E5 capacity.
claims.quote: With the inclusion model, which provides 400 SCUs per 1,000 user licenses, there's no hourly provisioned capacity. Instead, the same two scenarios would deduct 3.5 SCUs from the monthly SCU allocation.

controlChecks.governs: Whether Security Copilot can query Microsoft 365 services such as Microsoft Purview for data
Whether the Microsoft Purview source is enabled in Security Copilot
